title: Simple, Transparent Packages
subtitle: Straightforward packages for Google services, analytics tracking and e-commerce website design. Choose the level of support that fits your business.

packages.name: GMC Audit & Report
packages.audience: For store owners who want to understand their Merchant Center account issues and the next steps.
items: Review of your Google Merchant Center account

packages.name: Product Feed Check & Fix
packages.audience: For stores that need up to 50 products checked and eligible product errors corrected.
items: Review product data and feed issues
Fix identified product errors within the agreed scope

packages.name: Full Website & GMC Compliance
packages.audience: For businesses that need a broader website compliance review and Merchant Center remediation.
items: Full website review for trust and policy compliance
Identify website and Merchant Center issues
Implement agreed website and GMC fixes
Submit for Google review where applicable
Ongoing checklist to help maintain compliance

customProjects: Need a tailored scope or ongoing support? Let's talk.
note: All prices are in USD. Website packages cover Shopify, Wix, WordPress or WooCommerce according to the agreed project scope. Domain, hosting, paid themes, apps, plugins, third-party subscriptions, product entry beyond the agreed scope and custom development are not included unless stated in the project agreement. Google review and verification timelines are controlled by Google.

serviceSections.title: Google Business Profile

Review services, description and profile completeness

packages.name: Profile Optimization

packages.name: Setup & Optimization

serviceSections.title: Google Analytics 4 (GA4)

Test tracking and identify data gaps
